Within the light of the Jewel-Treasury Moon, with a single mind of reverence and respect, join [your palms].
With palms joined, he made offerings and paid homage to the Honored One, the Venerable One, the World-Honored One, and spoke these words: "Bhagavān."
The Honored One, the Perfectly Awakened One, the Worthy One, the Fully Enlightened One, the One Endowed with Knowledge and Conduct,
the Sugata, the Knower of the World, the Unsurpassed Leader of Men to be Tamed, the Teacher of Gods and Humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One—
having thus spoken, he taught, exhorted, inspired, and gladdened them. Thus it was said.

Having thus spoken these words—“Buddha-ratna-garbha-candra-prabha-bodhi-vākyaṃ śṛṇu ekāgra-cittaṃ sādhu yathāvad evam uktam”—[the Blessed One] said: The Buddha, the Jewel-Treasury, the Moonlight of Enlightenment, spoke these words:
"Listen attentively with a one-pointed mind; it is as I shall now explain. Having thus spoken, [he continued]:
If there are good sons or good daughters who wish to [attain] the treasury of jewels, the bodhisattva, having made this true and authentic statement, [should know that]...
"O Bhagavān, how can those such as they [attain] the state of a world-honored one? The World-Honored One replied:
"Excellent, excellent! O Mañjuśrī, you have spoken well."
O noble son of the lineage of the brave, born for the sake of great benefit and profit for the many sentient beings,
you are able to bring about peace and happiness;
you can generate the wisdom and insight of the three worlds.
Therefore, virtuous sons and daughters should know that these eight kinds of bodhisattva minds are the seeds from which [the state of] the Tathāgata arises;
they are characterized by the complete cessation and exhaustion of all afflictions.
The five [types of] uninterrupted sins and all [other] transgressions are entirely purified and brought to completion;
this is called the *Tathāgata-garbha* (Womb of the Thus-Come One).
By means of the mind, one makes offerings to it. (Transliterated phonetically: *oṃ vajra-tathāgata-garbha hūṃ*)
Contemplate: *Avalokiteśvara-bodhisattva-hṛdaya*. This is named Maitreya-bodhisattva-hṛdaya. This is named Ākāśa (Space).
